description: This Java class 'VertxProperties' defines configurable properties for Vert.x, including native transport preference, metrics enabling, event loop execution time, and DNS query timeout. It provides setters to modify these properties and a method to configure VertxOptions accordingly.

classes.name: VertxProperties
classes.description: A configuration class that manages properties for Vert.x instances, including native transport preference, metrics, event loop timing, and DNS timeout, and provides a method to apply these properties to a VertxOptions object.

methods.name: setPreferNative
methods.description: Sets the preference for using native networking transport in Vert.x.

methods.name: setEnableMetrics
methods.description: Enables or disables the Vert.x metrics system, integrating with Micrometer via Spring Boot.

methods.name: setMaxEventLoopExecuteTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum execution time (in milliseconds) allowed for tasks on the event loop before considering them blocking.

methods.name: setDnsQueryTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration (in milliseconds) for DNS queries.

methods.name: configureVertx
methods.description: Applies the configured properties to a VertxOptions object and returns the updated options.
